2607.02510.title: Online Safety Monitoring for LLMs
2607.02510.paper_summary: Despite alignment training, LLMs remain prone to generating unsafe outputs at deployment time. Monitoring outputs online and raising an alarm when safety can no longer be assumed is therefore critical. We study a simple real-time monitor that turns a verifier signal from an external model into an alarm decision by thresholding, with the threshold calibrated via risk control. In experiments on mathematical reasoning and red teaming datasets, we show that this simple design is competitive with more advanced monitors based on sequential hypothesis testing.
2607.02510.paper_summary_zh: 儘管經過對齊訓練，LLMs 在部署時仍然容易產生不安全的輸出。因此，線上監控輸出並在安全性無法再被假設時發出警報是至關重要的。我們研究了一個簡單的實時監控器，它通過閾值設定將來自外部模型的驗證信號轉換為警報決策，閾值則通過風險控制進行校準。在數學推理和紅隊數據集的實驗中，我們顯示這一簡單設計在性能上與基於序列假設檢驗的更先進監控器相當。
2607.02510.author: Mona Schirmer et.al.
2607.02510.authors: Mona Schirmer, Metod Jazbec, Alexander Timans, Christian Naesseth, Maja Waldron, Eric Nalisnick
